findings.one_line: The asserted bidirectional parameter-independent deficiency kernels are not derived: total-variation convergence of the central score and a maximal common-part coupling do not by themselves give a reverse kernel uniformly for the exponentially tilted family; the proof must construct an intertwining kernel (or prove the required uniformly tilted TV bound and conditional reconstruction). The displayed likelihoods also use undefined \nu in place of the local direction u.
